command:
set -euo pipefail
listeners="$(lsof -nP -iTCP:46327 -sTCP:LISTEN)"
printf "%s\n" "$listeners"
[[ "$listeners" == *"100.64.0.14:46327 (LISTEN)"* ]]
[[ "$listeners" != *"*:46327 (LISTEN)"* ]]
body_file="$(mktemp)"
trap "rm -f \"$body_file\"" EXIT
for host in 100.64.0.14 sweetmac14.sweet.home; do
  root_code="$(curl --noproxy "*" -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://$host:46327/")"
  api_code="$(curl --noproxy "*" -sS -o "$body_file" -w "%{http_code}" "http://$host:46327/api/v1/live-snapshot?request=1")"
  rg -q "\"source\":\"loop-registry-live\"" "$body_file"
  printf "http://%s:46327/ -> %s; live snapshot -> %s, validated live source\n" "$host" "$root_code" "$api_code"
  [[ "$root_code" == "200" && "$api_code" == "200" ]]
done
